text: what is the capital of india
The capital of India is **New Delhi**.
what is the biggest dataset used

The biggest dataset used in the project is the **AI Model Arena** dataset. 

It contains roughly **97,000 records** covering 461 AI language and multimodal models from 66 organizations across five competition categories from mid-2023 to the present. 

For comparison, the other primary structured dataset, the **Global Happiness Index (GHI)**, contains about 2,360 records spanning 165 countries from 2005 to 2023.
